limitations: Dash duration fixed at 8 frames so per-frame dash step is dashDistance/8
Dash direction is locked at dash start from the normalized input vector; neutral dash uses +x
contract.name: Donor dash and walking motion

rules.description: Walking moves at walkingSpeed along normalized direction (2 px/frame straight, 1.414 per axis diagonal); dash moves 7.5 px/frame along normalized direction (5.303 per axis diagonal); controlled intervention diverged dx 7.5 vs control 2 on first X+right frame
Dash start sets cooldown 25 and remaining 7, remaining decrements each following dash frame to 0 with dash-end on the 8th frame, cooldown stays 25 while dashing then decrements on non-dash frames
ownsMotion is true only on dash frames, dash-start/dash-end events occur at dash boundaries, level-held X starts a dash when cooldown reaches 0, and a dash with no directional input goes +x

contract.scope: Standalone both-axis walking and dash motion at 60Hz: normalized walking displacement, 8-frame normalized dash, cooldown/remaining timers, dash-start/dash-end events and ownsMotion only while dashing.
contract.stateDescription: JSON state with integer cooldown and remaining timer fields, plus locked dash direction dashDirX/dashDirY stored as unit-vector floats. remaining counts 7 down to 0 after the dash-start frame, giving 8 dash frames total. Initial cooldown defaults to 10 and decrements on non-dash frames.
